Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 6124 of 2024
Applicant :- Shresth Bhalla And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Deepak Maurya,Sahil Srivastava,Shikhar Chandra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the following prayers:-
"a. stay further proceedings in Criminal Case No. 13695/2023 and Crime No.
86/2023 titled as "State Vs. Shresth Bhalla & Ors.", pending trial before the Ld. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bareilly, U.P., arising out of the FIR No. 86/2023 under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 504, 506 IPC & Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961,
registered in Mahila Thana, Bareilly, U.P., charge sheet filed on 02.11.2023, during the pendency of the trial before the court below."
3.
It is strange that the present prayer has been made for stay of the further proceedings in a criminal case.

There is no prayer for quashing of the proceedings nor any cognizance order or Shresth Bhalla And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10739012/

The present application is filed by Sri Deepak Maurya,
Advocate, Enrollment No. UP/8098/2020, AOR No. A/D0353/2021, Sri Sahil Srivastava,
Enrollment No. UP/16612/2022, AOR No. A/S0126/2023, Sri Shikkhar Chandra, Enrollment No.
UP09028/2020, AOR No. A/S1272/2022 and Sri Ashish Hira, Enrollment No. D/7259/2017.
Four counsels have signed the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
The prayer in the present case is only for stay of the proceedings.
The stay of the proceedings cannot be a final prayer.

4. On a pointed query being made to learned counsel for the applicants as to how final relief by way of stay of proceedings can be granted, learned counsel for the applicants could not give any explanation or show any law in this respect.
5. It is to be seen that in the present case the final relief sought by the applicants is for stay of the proceedings in the criminal case.
The stay of proceedings of a criminal case cannot under law be granted as a final relief.
The prayer made in the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is misconceived.
6. Certainly the present prayer in the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is nothing but an abuse of the process of law.
Such being the position, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is not maintainable and is dismissed.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 VMA  Shresth Bhalla And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10739012/
